verdict.rationale: An in-product AI assistant is a fair question for a commerce and payments platform, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows PayPal shipping a built-in assistant inside its own product that users can delegate tasks to. What the evidence does show is all external: an MCP server for third-party MCP clients, an agent toolkit for building custom agents, and payment rails that external assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini) call into. None of that is a native assistant inside PayPal.
